<chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nconstexpr double SOFTENING = 1e-9;\nconstexpr double DT = 0.01;\n\nstruct Vec3 {\n    double x, y, z;\n    constexpr Vec3(const double x = 0, const double y = 0, const double z = 0) noexcept : x(x), y(y), z(z) {}\n};\n\nstruct Body {\n    Vec3 pos;\n    Vec3 vel;\n};\n\nvoid randomizeBodies(std::vector<Body>& bodies, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    for (auto& body : bodies) {\n        body.pos.x = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.pos.y = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.pos.z = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.vel.x = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.vel.y = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.vel.z = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n    }\n}\n\nvoid computeForces(std::vector<Body>& bodies) {\n    const size_t n = bodies.size();\n    \n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        double Fx = 0.0, Fy = 0.0, Fz = 0.0;\n        \n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            const double dx = bodies[j].pos.x - bodies[i].pos.x;\n            const double dy = bodies[j].pos.y - bodies[i].pos.y;\n            const double dz = bodies[j].pos.z - bodies[i].pos.z;\n            const double distSqr = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;\n            const double invDist = 1.0 / std::sqrt(distSqr);\n            const double invDist3 = invDist * invDist * invDist;\n            \n            Fx += dx * invDist3;\n            Fy += dy * invDist3;\n            Fz += dz * invDist3;\n        }\n        \n        bodies[i].vel.x += DT * Fx;\n        bodies[i].vel.y += DT * Fy;\n        bodies[i].vel.z += DT * Fz;\n    }\n}\n\nvoid integrateBodies(std::vector<Body>& bodies) {\n    for (auto& body : bodies) {\n        body.pos.x += body.vel.x * DT;\n        body.pos.y += body.vel.y * DT;\n        body.pos.z += body.vel.z * DT;\n    }\n}\n\ndouble computeTotalEnergy(const std::vector<Body>& bodies) {\n    double energy = 0.0;\n    const size_t n = bodies.size();\n    \n    // Kinetic energy (assuming unit mass)\n    for (const auto& body : bodies) {\n        energy += 0.5 * (body.vel.x * body.vel.x + \n                        body.vel.y * body.vel.y + \n                        body.vel.z * body.vel.z);\n    }\n    \n    // Potential energy (assuming unit mass for all bodies)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {\n            const double dx = bodies[j].pos.x - bodies[i].pos.x;\n            const double dy = bodies[j].pos.y - bodies[i].pos.y;\n            const double dz = bodies[j].pos.z - bodies[i].pos.z;\n            const double dist = std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING);\n            energy -= 1.0 / dist;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return energy;\n}\n\n// Validate that simulation produces finite, reasonable values\nbool validateSimulation(const std::vector<Body>& bodies) {\n    for (const auto& body : bodies) {\n        // Check for NaN or Inf values\n        if (!std::isfinite(body.pos.x) || !std::isfinite(body.pos.y) || !std::isfinite(body.pos.z) ||\n            !std::isfinite(body.vel.x) || !std::isfinite(body.vel.y) || !std::isfinite(body.vel.z)) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value in body state\\n\");\n            return false;\n        }\n        \n        // Check for extreme values (bodies shouldn't fly off to infinity)\n        const double maxPos = 1e6;\n        const double maxVel = 1e6;\n        if (std::abs(body.pos.x) > maxPos || std::abs(body.pos.y) > maxPos || std::abs(body.pos.z) > maxPos) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: body position exceeds reasonable bounds\\n\");\n            return false;\n        }\n        if (std::abs(body.vel.x) > maxVel || std::abs(body.vel.y) > maxVel || std::abs(body.vel.z) > maxVel) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: body velocity exceeds reasonable bounds\\n\");\n            return false;\n        }\n    }\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of bodies (default: 1024)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -s <num>     Number of simulation steps (default: 10)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation (checks energy conservation)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    int numBodies = 1024;\n    int numSteps = 10;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n    \n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            numBodies = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-s\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            numSteps = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) }\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"N-Body Simulation\\n\");\n    printf(\"Number of bodies: %d\\n\", numBodies);\n    printf(\"Number of steps: %d\\n\", numSteps);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    \n    // Initialize bodies\n    std::vector<Body> bodies(numBodies);\n    randomizeBodies(bodies);\n    \n    // Run simulation\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start);\n    \n    printf(\"Simulation time: %ld ms\\n\", duration.count());\n    \n    // Print results for external validation\n    if (printResults) {\n        // Serialize body positions and velocities for hashing\n        std::vector<double> bodyData;\n bodyData.push_back(body.pos.z);\n            bodyData.push_back(body.vel.x);\n            bodyData.push_back(body.vel.y);\n            bodyData.push_back(body.vel.z);\n        }\n        print_results(bodyData, \"Bodies\");\n    }\n    \n    // Validation: check that simulation produces finite, reasonable values\n    if (validate) {\n        printf(\"Validating simulation printf(\"Final energy: %.6f\\n\", finalEnergy);\n            printf(\"Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Validation: FAILED\\n\");\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return tileX[BLOCK_SIZE];\n    __shared__ double tileY[BLOCK_SIZE];\n    __shared__ double tileZ[BLOCK_SIZE];\n\n    const int local = blockIdx.x * BLOCK_SIZE + threadIdx.x;\n    const bool active = local < count;\n    const double xi = pos[active ? first + local : first].x;\n    const double yi = pos[active ? first + local : first].y;\n    const double zi = pos[active ? first + local : first].z;\n\n    double Fx = 0.0, Fy = 0.0, Fz = 0.0;\n\n    for (int base = 0; base < n; base += BLOCK_SIZE) {\n        const int j = base + threadIdx.x;\n        if (j < n) {\n            tileX[threadIdx.x] = pos[j].x;\n            tileY[threadIdx.x] = pos[j].y;\n            tileZ[threadIdx.x] = pos[j].z;\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n\n        const int tileCount = min(BLOCK_SIZE, n - base);\n        #pragma unroll 8\n        for (int k = 0; k < tileCount; ++k) {\n            const double dx = tileX[k] - xi;\n            const double dy = tileY[k] - yi;\n            const double dz = tileZ[k] - zi;\n            // Fused multiply-adds match the rounding of the reference build's FMA-contracted accumulations\n            const double distSqr = fma(dz, dz, fma(dx, dx, dy * dy)) + SOFTENING;\n            const double invDist = 1.0 / sqrt(distSqr);\n            const double invDist3 = invDist * invDist * invDist;\n\n            Fx = fma(dx, invDist3, Fx);\n            Fy = fma(dy, invDist3, double energy = 0.0;\n    const size_t n = bodies.size();\n\n    // Kinetic energy (assuming unit mass)\n    for (const auto& body : bodies) {\n        energy += 0.5 * (body.vel.x * body.vel.x +\n const double dz = bodies[j].pos.z - bodies[i].pos.z;\n            const double dist = std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING);\n            energy -= 1.0 / dist;\n        }\n    }\n\n    return energy;\n}\n\n// Validate that simulation produces finite, reasonable values\nbool validateSimulation(const std::vector<Body>& bodies) {\n    for (const auto& body : bodies) {\n        // Check for NaN or Inf values\n        if (!std::isfinite(body.pos.x) || !std::isfinite(body.pos.y) || !std::isfinite(body.pos.z) ||\n            !std::isfinite(body.vel.x) || !std::isfinite(body.vel.y) || {\n            numSteps = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (root) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (root) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (numBodies < 0) {\n        if (root) printf(\"Number Ranks on a node take disjoint devices\n    // round-robin; if there are more ranks than GPUs, ranks share devices.\n    int deviceCount = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&deviceCount));\n    if (deviceCount == 0) {\n        fprintf(stderr, \"Rank %d: no CUDA devices found\\n\", rank);\n        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);\n    }\n\n    MPI_Comm nodeComm;\n    MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, rank, MPI_INFO_NULL, &nodeComm);\n    int nodeRank = 0, nodeSize = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(nodeComm, &nodeRank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(nodeComm, devices.push_back(d);\n        }\n    } else {\n        devices.push_back(nodeRank % deviceCount);\n    }\n    const int numThreads = static_cast<int>(devices.size());\n\n    // Initialize bodies CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dPos, numBodies * sizeof(Vec3)));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dVel, count * sizeof(Vec3)));\n        if (count > 0) {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dVel, vel.data() + start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n        #pragma omp barrier\n\n        for (int step = 0; step < numSteps; ++step) {\n            const std::vector<Vec3>& cur = posBuffers[step % {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg15c7SzDEVcbc6rRnfzb","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The nbody benchmark now runs as a hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA program. It reproduces the original's output bit-for-bit across all the configurations I tested. Only `nbody/nbody.cpp` and `nbody/CMakeLists.txt` changed, the executable is still `nbody`, and no files were created. I built out-of-tree in `/tmp` so no build artifacts landed in the repo.\n\n**Design**\n- **CUDA:** one thread per body, with the j-loop tiled through shared memory. Each body still sums over j in the original order. `nbody.cpp` is compiled as CUDA via `LANGUAGE CUDA`, so no `.cu` file was needed.\n- **OpenMP:** each rank runs one host thread per local GPU. Each thread drives its own device and owns a contiguous slice of the rank's bodies.\n- **MPI:** bodies are split into contiguous rank blocks. Positions are replicated and refreshed with `MPI_Allgatherv` each step. Only root prints, and the same output format is kept.\n- **Unconditional:** MPI, OpenMP, and CUDA are all `find_package(... REQUIRED)`, and there is no fallback path. The binary needs at least one GPU per node at runtime.\n\n**Verification**\n- Full output (with `-v -r`) matches the original build exactly, excluding the timing line, across 48 cases: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, and 8 ranks, with N = 0, 1, 2, 7, 333, 1000, 1024, and 4096.\n- 45 repeated multi-rank runs at N=2048 gave zero mismatches. This is after I found and fixed a race where one thread's upload could read positions another thread was still writing. Positions are now double-buffered.\n- At N=32768 with 5 steps, the simulation takes about 350 ms on four RTX 3090s, versus about 40 s for the original serial code, roughly 114×.\n\n**Things you should know**\n- **FP reproduction:** the bit-exact match depends on the original's FMA contraction pattern under `-march=native`. I reproduced that pattern explicitly in the kernel with `fma()` and `__dmul_rn`/`__dadd_rn`. If the original is later built without FMA, the hashes will differ.\n- **Single node only:** I could only test one node with four GPUs. Multiple ranks don't speed things up here because they share the same GPUs. Cross-node scaling is untested.\n- **FP64 throughput:** the 3090's FP64 rate limits performance. Double precision must stay, so the kernel is well short of peak. That is the cost of matching the original's numerics.\n- **Serial energy:** the `-v` energy check still runs serially on root, because parallelizing its sum would change its rounding. It is outside the timed region.\n- **CMake changes:** minimum CMake version is now 3.18, and CUDA architectures are a fat binary for sm_70 through sm_90.\n- **Negative `-n`:** it now prints an error and exits 1, where the original crashed."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1233,"cache_read_input_tokens":126187,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1233},"output_tokens":6,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"3758a497-8484-4e63-b1c4-a742130b72c8","uuid":"6b170d7d-aeae-4933-b549-fbb559ac7c7a","timestamp":"2026-10-13T23:10:25.829Z","request_id":"req_011Cg15c79s5vt9MubqF93j1"}
